=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: lines 655-663 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The unverified-checkout gate sets `SHOULD_RUN="false"` but leaves `DETERMINISTIC_SKIP` enabled, allowing the deterministic-skip-merge job to auto-merge a qualifying fork or invalid-head PR without review.
  WHY: `deterministic-skip-merge` is gated by `deterministic_skip` and uses the populated PR head SHA; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro disputes this finding, reasoning that deterministic-skip evaluation is gated on `SHOULD_RUN` and therefore cannot run after the unverified-checkout block sets it to false.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py: line 113 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The test looks up the retired workflow step `Hand review round to Claude session (Claude-fixer mode)`, which is absent from the workflow.
  WHY: The lookup in `steps[name]` raises an uncaught `KeyError`; openai_gpt-6-luna rated this MAJOR rather than BLOCKER.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: lines 406-478 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets()` mishandles push option and destination forms, causing the guard to check the current branch instead of the explicitly targeted branch for some pushes.
  WHY: Pushes using forms such as `--repo` or `HEAD` can evade merged-PR destination checks, and reviewers report five failing tests; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro says those test failures are pre-existing and not actionable in this review.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: lines 3713-3724 (after fetch) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The post-fetch branch-movement check masks `git rev-parse` failures and reports them as PR-head movement.
  WHY: A git failure causes the review to skip with a misleading stale-base diagnosis; this is a diagnostic issue rather than a failure to fail closed.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: lines 2555-2566 and 3635-3640 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The OpenCode configuration rejection blocks hard-fail review runs when project OpenCode configuration exists, with no operator escape hatch.
  WHY: Repositories that legitimately track these files cannot run dispatched reviews without removing them; the implicit-execution guard consequently blocks the entire review run.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: line 3636 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The split-workspace OpenCode configuration check does not guard against an empty `WORKSPACE_PATH` before checking paths.
  WHY: An empty workspace path makes the check inspect root-filesystem paths instead of the intended workspace, potentially letting the guard pass when workspace setup failed.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py: line 62, function name `test_workflow_checks_out_pr_head_ref_for_judge_context` | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test function name still refers to “judge context” although the test now checks dispatched-review checkout behavior.
  WHY: The stale name misleads readers about what the test covers; there is no runtime failure.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Add a regression test that a dispatched run's reviewer workspace is the PR-head checkout."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, in a review test job
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The regression tests are in `tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py`, but no CI test job invokes that module; reviewers report no matching invocation in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `mark-stable.yml`, `test-and-mark-stable.yml`, or consumer workflows.
- requirement: "Fork, missing-repo and invalid-head PRs skip both review and deterministic auto-merge."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` gate block at lines 651-663 and `deterministic-skip-merge` job at line 1861
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The unverified-checkout gate sets `SHOULD_RUN="false"` but leaves `DETERMINISTIC_SKIP` unchanged; the merge job checks only `deterministic_skip`, and no regression test covers `review_checkout_unverified`. deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro disputes the reported implementation bug, stating that deterministic-skip evaluation is gated behind `SHOULD_RUN` and is skipped after it becomes false.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py: line 113 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The for-loop includes the retired step name `"Hand review round to Claude session (Claude-fixer mode)"`, so the `steps` dict lookup raises `KeyError`.
  WHY: The step no longer exists in the workflow YAML, and the uncaught `KeyError` fails the test.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: the branch-movement guard at lines 3713-3724 (after fetch) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The guard uses `$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)`, conflating git command failure with branch advancement.
  WHY: The review is skipped with a misleading “PR head moved after source checkout” warning when git infrastructure fails.
- tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py: line 62, function name `test_workflow_checks_out_pr_head_ref_for_judge_context` | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The function name still says “for judge context” although the test now checks dispatched checkout behavior.
  WHY: A future reader searching for “judge context” may assume it tests judge behavior.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Add a regression test that a dispatched run's reviewer workspace is the PR-head checkout." (from linked issue #5824 acceptance criteria)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` under one of the four test jobs, most naturally `tests-promote-stall-and-review`
  Evidence of absence: The tests are added to `tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py`, but no pytest invocation in any CI job references this file.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, the two OpenCode config rejection blocks (lines ~2555-2565 and ~3628-3633): both blocks fail hard with `exit 1` and have no kill-switch env var; suggested minimal fix is a default-true `REVIEW_REJECT_OPENCODE_CONFIG_ENABLED` env var that warns and continues when false. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

  PROBLEM: `_push_targets()` lacks push option tracking for `--repo` and `--repo=`, rejects valid commit references containing tildes such as `HEAD~0`, and diverges from `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`.

  PROBLEM: The test references the retired step `"Hand review round to Claude session (Claude-fixer mode)"`.
  WHY: Accessing `steps["Hand review round to Claude session (Claude-fixer mode)"]` raises an unhandled `KeyError`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Add a regression test that a dispatched run's reviewer workspace is the PR-head checkout.
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` under job tests-promote-stall-and-review
  Evidence of absence: `tests/test_review_autofix_merge_precheck.py` is not included in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; none of the four CI test jobs invokes pytest on this test file.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, location line 3636, OpenCode workspace check: if `WORKSPACE_PATH` is unset or empty, the path check tests `/opencode.json` and other paths against the root filesystem. Suggested minimal fix: wrap the loop with `if [ -n "${WORKSPACE_PATH:-}" ]; then ... fi`. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
